capabilities: Sort Inbox notes into configured Projects, Areas, Resources, and Archives folders
Reschedule, archive, or trash notes whose expiration date has passed
Archive and return whole Projects with a movement history in the main note
Fill in only missing required metadata (links, expiration dates) when sorting notes
Run review sessions through hotkey-bound commands with pause, skip, and close states
disambiguation: Review here means triaging an Inbox and overdue notes into PARA folders, not spaced-repetition flashcard review.
extras: Detailed product documentation is maintained separately, in Russian, in the author's own vault; community directory submission is pending, and the plugin is stated to be local-only with no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no guided workflow for triaging accumulated Inbox notes and overdue dated notes into a PARA folder structure with safe, reversible moves.

relations.evidence: two user-started review workflows shared with nvim-obsidian-para-flow

summary: PARA review workflow that sorts Inbox notes and expired notes into configured Projects, Areas, Resources, and Archives folders with transactional safety checks.
